Name: Rose Iridium Pans for Love of Cooking
Author: MissHP
Description:
I'm a long-time user of [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/LooneyLuny?gameId=1303]LooneyLuny's[/url] beautiful pink tool recolor [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23982]Rose Iridium Tools and Weapons[/url], and the matching recolor for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24580]Alternative Textures and Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ tools by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/zaoux?gameId=1303]zaoux[/url]. All that to say when I finally tried [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]The Love of Cooking[/url]﻿ (from [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/bblueberry?gameId=1303]bblueberry[/url]), the pan tool colors gave me a jump scare since I haven't seen the Vanilla ones in some time. So I tried my hand at a recolor! 

This is a sprite replacement that patches the other sprite sheets from Love of Cooking - there is no need to replace your existing mod files, this will treat it as a dependency and patch the new sprites. 

Credit for pretty much all of the assets goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55973382]LooneyLuny[/url]﻿.

Also, if you want everything to be pink and cute, check out the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36249]Overgrown Flowery Interface compatibility for The Love of Cooking[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Ailuji?gameId=1303]Ailuji[/url]

[b]HOW TO INSTALL:[/b]

To install the mod, copy "[CP] Rose Iridium Pans for Love of Cooking" into your "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder. Make sure you have your other mods, especially SMAPI and Content Patcher, up to date.
